title: Extend glossary + a pack to a second language pair
context: Repeatability is demonstrated by covering a second language pair, so the glossary (and a pack) extend to a second target language. A qualified reviewer of the new language is required. It builds on the first glossary.
objective: Extend the glossary to a second language pair with register/gender handling and qualified-reviewer sign-off.
acceptanceCriteria: glossaries/<src>-<tgt2>.yaml has >= 25 terms with term, translation or preserve, partOfSpeech, register, genderForms (where applicable), notes
Terminology reviewed and signed off by a qualified speaker of the second target language
Derived terms recorded against the allow-list; no uncleared sources used
Validates against glossarySchema and passes CI structural checks
